'''Dragon Gate Team''' (abbreviated DG) is a professional esports based in [[:Category:Taiwan|Taiwan]], The parent company is HONGKONG FISH DIVE INT'L CULTURE MEDIA LIMITED.

On the 23rd of April in 2019, '''Dragon Gate Team''' were banned from the '''LMS''' for betting on other teams and matchfixing games. This resulted in the owner ''Hu Wei-Jie'' being banned from ever being associated with a League of Legends team again, while [[yoga]] and [[xiaoyu]] are suspended for 12 months. [[JGY]] was banned for 18 months. As a result of the bans, '''Dragon Gate Team''' disbanded with all players leaving the team. <ref name="team banned">{{cite web |url=https://2019.lms.garena.tw/news/content/3372 |title=Dragon Gate Team suspension announcement |date=2019-04-23 |author=''Garena'' |publisher=''Garena'' |language={{Flag|cn}} Chinese}}</ref>
